name: Prosciutto-Orzo Bake with Zucchini, Pepper, Corn, Feta & Hot Honey

instructions.primary_message: Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 medium zucchini squash
1 red bell pepper
½ lemon
½ small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add prosciutto in a single layer and cook until crispy, 1-2 minutes per side. Remove to a plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and medium dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium yellow onion
1 clove garlic

instructions.primary_message: Trim and coarsely grate zucchini. Add to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.

Return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, corn, and spices; cook, until veggies are slightly caramelized and liquid has evaporated, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ cup frozen corn
½ tsp smoked paprika
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are caramelized, juice lemon into the skillet. Add orzo, broth, milk, half of the feta (reserve remaining feta for serving), salt, and pepper, then stir to combine. Place skillet in the oven and bake until liquid is absorbed and orzo is tender, 12-15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
5 oz orzo pasta
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
4 fl oz (½ cup) whole milk
½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Place in the reserved bowl.
Crumble or chop prosciutto into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the basil and set aside.
Place honey and crushed red pepper in a small bowl. Stir to combine the hot honey.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp honey
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the orzo is done, remove from the oven. Add basil, prosciutto, and half of the hot honey to the skillet, then stir to combine. (Reserve remaining hot honey for serving.)
To serve, divide orzo bake between plates or bowls, then top with reserved feta and hot honey. Enjoy!
